remarks:
Situated on a beautifully wooded lot of nearly one acre overlooking the fourth hole of Crag Burn Golf Club, one of Western New York’s most exclusive private golf clubs, this remarkable contemporary home offers 3,312 square feet of living space in a truly exceptional setting. Proudly offered by its original owners, this four bedroom, two full and two half bath home combines distinctive architectural details, generous living spaces, and significant recent improvements.
A dramatic entry welcomes you with soaring ceilings, beautiful natural woodwork, and an impressive staircase. Throughout the home, cathedral ceilings, exposed wood beams, skylights, and three wood burning fireplaces create warmth and architectural interest. Just off the kitchen is a phenomenal den and sitting room featuring a beautiful exposed brick wall, wood burning fireplace, wet bar, and striking exposed ceiling beams. This inviting space is perfect for entertaining or simply relaxing by the fire. Additional living areas include a spacious great room, formal dining room, and fully rebuilt three season room overlooking the picturesque grounds.
The beautifully renovated kitchen, completed in 2022, features quality Candlelight cabinetry, quartz countertops, a center island, and a spacious walk in pantry. A convenient first floor laundry room and mudroom add everyday functionality. Upstairs, four bedrooms include a spacious primary suite. The partially finished basement provides additional recreational space and abundant storage.
Major improvements include a new boiler in 2022, along with central air conditioning installed in 2013. Additional highlights include 200 amp electrical service, a sump pump with water powered backup, a permanent whole house generator, and an expansive attached 3.5 car garage.
Located within the desirable Iroquois School District, this exceptional property offers privacy, character, and beautiful golf course surroundings while remaining convenient to the Village of East Aurora. Open House 10/17 from 1:00-3:00PM. Offers will be reviewed 10/20 at noon.
